p, k = map(int, input().split())
parent = list(range(p))
size = [1] * p

def find_root(u):
    while parent[u] != u:
        parent[u] = parent[parent[u]]
        u = parent[u]
    return u

def union_sets(u, v):
    u = find_root(u)
    v = find_root(v)
    if u != v:
        size[u] += size[v]
        parent[v] = u

def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def check_power(a, b, p):
    res = 1
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res * a) % p
        a = (a * a) % p
        b >>= 1
    return p if res == 1 else 1

if k == 0:

else:
    parent = list(range(p))
    for i in range(p):
        v = (k * i) % p
        union_sets(i, v)

    answer = 1
    for i in range(p):
        if find_root(i) == i:
            answer = (answer * check_power(k, size[i], p)) % 1000000007

    print(answer)
